description: This file defines a PHP interface 'HeaderDefinition' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Report\Header. The interface outlines methods for normalizing header objects to an array and retrieving associated metadata, implementing contract for header-related classes in the report module.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts the header object to an associative array representation.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with the header as a ParameterBag, or null if not available.
